jobs.description:
Job Requisition ID: 180814 

 About Al-Futtaim
Established in the 1930s, Al-Futtaim is one of the most diversified and progressive privately held regional businesses, headquartered in Dubai. Operating across more than 20 countries, the Group spans automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and health. With more than 40,000 employees, Al-Futtaim represents over 200 of the world’s most recognised brands, including Toyota, Lexus, IKEA, ACE and Marks & Spencer. Driven by its purpose to enrich lives and elevate communities, Al-Futtaim focuses on digital innovation, AI, sustainable growth and strategic partnerships, creating long-term value for customers, communities and partners while building a responsible legacy for future generations.
 
 Overview Of The Role: 

 The Finance Manager in the Corporate Division is responsible for leading Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) and acting as a finance business partner. The role encompasses budget preparation, forecasting, management reporting, cost allocations, and generating performance insights. The Finance Manager will partner with various business divisions to enable data-driven decision-making, cost optimization, and value creation. This role requires strong coordination across multiple entities including Group Finance, business divisions, and other stakeholders.

 What You Will Do: 

 Budgeting, Forecasting and Cost Allocations 
 
 Lead the annual budgeting and periodic forecasting process for the Corporate and GTDP function.

 Consolidate divisional inputs and challenge assumptions.

 Align financial plans with Group strategic targets.

 Ensure budgets and forecasts are submitted accurately within Group timelines.

 Maintain forecast accuracy within an agreed tolerance (e.g., 5% of actuals).

 Complete cost allocations for divisions using the approved allocation model.

 Identify and implement improvement opportunities in the cost allocation model.

 Management Reporting & Financial Analysis 
 
 Deliver timely and accurate monthly MIS and P&L performance reporting.

 Conduct variance analysis versus budget and forecast.

 Provide clear commentary on drivers, risks, and opportunities.

 Publish monthly MIS and CFO/CTO dashboards by agreed timelines.

 Develop automated, self-service dashboards to reduce manual effort.

 Cash Flow Planning & Forecasting 
 
 Prepare and submit bi-weekly cash flow forecasts within agreed timelines.

 Align forecasted cash requirements with business plans.

 Analyze and explain variances between forecast and actual cash movements.

 Cost & Profitability Analysis and Optimization 
 
 Analyze key cost drivers and profitability across entities.

 Drive cost optimization and margin improvement opportunities.

 Complete cost driver and profitability analysis each reporting cycle.

 Improve recovery and utilization rates.

 Planning Process Excellence & Automation 
 
 Drive continuous improvement and automation of planning and reporting processes.

 Leverage SAP, Power BI, and data platforms for enhanced speed and accuracy.

 Implement automation and process improvement initiatives.

 Reduce reporting cycle time and manual effort.

 Business Partnering & Decision Support 
 
 Act as a trusted finance business partner to leadership.

 Translate financial data into actionable insights.

 Hold regular business review meetings with divisions and functions.

 Provide responsive and insightful recommendations for decision-making.

 Required Skills To Be Successful: 

 Strong financial planning and analysis capabilities.

 Proficiency in SAP, Power BI, and advanced Excel.

 Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

 Ability to drive process improvements and cost optimizations.

 What Qualifies You For The Role: 

 Bachelor's degree in accounting or finance; professional qualification (CA/CPA/CIMA/ACCA) preferred.

 5-8 years of experience in financial control and management.

 Strong accounting, analytical, and problem-solving capabilities.

 Hands-on experience with SAP (FICO/BPC/SAC), Power BI, and advanced Excel.

 Ability to influence and collaborate with cross-functional teams.

 Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.

 We’re here to provide excellent service but a little help from you can ensure a five-star candidate experience from start to finish.

 Before you click “apply”: Please read the job description carefully to ensure you can confidently demonstrate why this opportunity is right for you and take the time to put together a well-crafted and personalised CV to further boost your visibility. Our global Talent Acquisition team members are all assigned to specific businesses to ensure that we make the best matches between talent and opportunities. We not only consider the requisite compatibility of skills and behaviours, but also how candidates align with our Values of Respect, Integrity, Collaboration, and Excellence.

 As part of our candidate experience promise, we also want to make ourselves available to you throughout the application process. We make every effort to review and respond to every application.

jobs.description:
JOB TITLE 
Finance Manager | Majid Al Futtaim Entertainment | Finance Department 
 ROLE SUMMARY 
 The Finance Manager – Cinemas Business Partnering acts as a strategic finance partner to Cinemas leadership and operations teams across multiple markets. The role transforms financial and operational data into actionable insights, supports budgeting, forecasting, performance reviews, and investment decisions, while leading F&B financial performance, margin management, and commercial decision support.
 ROLE PROFILE 
 Partner with Cinemas operations and commercial teams to evaluate site and portfolio performance, lead performance reviews, and provide clear variance analysis and recommended actions.

 Lead budgeting, rolling forecasts, financial consolidation, and annual operating plans across admissions, F&B, other revenues, and operating costs.

 Develop KPI dashboards and management reporting to provide clear insights into key financial and operational business drivers.

 Support financial evaluations and business cases for new cinema openings, refurbishments, capital investments, and strategic initiatives.

 Act as the lead finance partner for F&B/Concessions, managing P&L performance, margins, COGS, wastage, product mix, and other key performance drivers.

 Provide financial analysis and commercial recommendations for F&B pricing, menu changes, promotions, new product launches, and operational initiatives.

 Partner with Procurement, Supply Chain, Pricing, Marketing, country finance teams, and other stakeholders to identify risks, opportunities, and improve commercial performance.

 Ensure consistent reporting and forecasting across markets while supporting cost optimization, new revenue streams, market expansion, and ad-hoc strategic projects.

 REQUIREMENTS 
 Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Economics, or a relevant discipline.

 6–8 years of progressive finance experience, including at least 3 years in FP&A or commercial business partnering.

 Experience partnering with operations in a multi-site consumer business such as cinema, leisure, retail, F&B, or hospitality; F&B margin or concessions experience is strongly preferred.

 Proven experience managing budgets, forecasts, financial analysis, investment appraisal, and business cases.

 Strong commercial acumen, analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and present recommendations to senior leadership.

 Advanced Excel and financial modelling skills; experience with BI tools such as Power BI and multi-country operations is an advantage.

jobs.description:
Key Responsibilities 

 1. Revenue Assurance & Controls 

 Ensure end‑to‑end revenue integrity across all business units—order‑to‑cash, billing, invoicing, and collections.

 Design, implement, and monitor strong internal controls to prevent revenue leakage.

 Lead periodic revenue reconciliation , variance analysis, and root-cause investigations.

 Review and validate pricing, contracts, discounts, promotions, and revenue adjustments.

 Drive compliance with IFRS and organizational policies for revenue recognition.

 2. Process Excellence & Transformation 

 Lead large-scale process transformation initiatives within the Shared Services Center to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and automation.

 Implement digital tools such as RPA, workflow automation, analytics dashboards, and AI/ML-based anomaly detection .

 Redesign workflows for standardization across geographies and businesses.

 Create KPIs and dashboards to measure performance, leakage, recovery, and process stability.

 3. Leadership & Stakeholder Management 

 Manage and mentor a multi-disciplinary team responsible for billing, audits, assurance checks, and reporting.

 Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams—Finance, Operations, IT, Commercial, Data Analytics.

 Influence senior stakeholders with insights and recommendations backed by strong analytics.

 Partner with internal audit and external auditors on revenue-related reviews.

 4. Continuous Improvement & Value Creation 

 Identify systemic gaps in revenue processes and execute corrective actions.

 Develop a roadmap for shared services scalability and maturity .

 Introduce best practices from global Shared Services/GBS frameworks.

 Establish governance models for periodic business reviews and improvement cycles.

 5. Reporting & Analytics 

 Deliver accurate and timely revenue assurance MIS, dashboards, KPIs, and performance scorecards.

 Analyze trends, identify anomalies, and highlight risks/opportunities.

 Prepare executive-level presentations for senior leadership and CFO reviews.

 Chartered Accountant with 8-10 years of experience
 7–12 years of experience in Finance Shared Services , Revenue Assurance , or Order-to-Cash , with at least 3–5 years in a managerial role.
 Proven track record leading transformational or digitalization projects .
 Strong understanding of ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, MS Dynamics) and automation tools (Power BI, Power Automate, RPA).
 Solid grasp of internal controls, contract management, and financial governance.

jobs.title: Vice President – Asset Management (Commercial)
jobs.description:
JOB PURPOSE
Lead the strategic management of Aldar's assigned commercial assets to maximize portfolio value, optimize financial performance, and enhance customer experience. Drive asset performance through leasing strategy, capital investment, service provider governance, sustainability initiatives, and cross-functional collaboration while supporting Aldar's long-term investment objectives.
The role is for the UAE national
 
ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
1. Strategic Asset & Portfolio Management
Develop and implement asset strategies to maximize long-term value and portfolio performance.
Drive portfolio optimization through asset repositioning, enhancement, and capital recycling initiatives.
Monitor market trends and asset performance to support strategic decision-making.
2. Financial Performance & Capital Management
Manage portfolio financial performance, including NOI, occupancy, yield, valuation, and total return.
Identify value creation opportunities and oversee annual business planning, budgeting, and financial reporting.
Support investment decisions through financial analysis and performance insights.
3. Leasing, Commercialisation & Tenant Experience
Lead leasing strategies to maximize occupancy, rental growth, and tenant retention.
Identify commercialisation opportunities and oversee tenant engagement initiatives to improve customer satisfaction and NPS.
Review key leasing transactions and ensure alignment with portfolio objectives.
4. Asset Enhancement & Development Coordination
Lead asset enhancement programmes and CAPEX initiatives to improve asset performance and customer experience.
Coordinate with Development, Legal, Finance, and Operations to ensure successful project delivery and asset handover.
Monitor post-completion performance against approved business cases.
5. Service Provider Governance
Oversee the performance of Property and Facilities Management service providers through agreed SLAs, KPIs, and governance frameworks.
Drive continuous improvement, operational excellence, and cost optimization across the portfolio.
6. Stakeholder & Portfolio Collaboration
Partner with internal business units, including Development, Finance, Legal, Retail, Hospitality, and Education, to deliver integrated portfolio initiatives.
Build and maintain effective relationships with tenants, brokers, consultants, contractors, and external stakeholders.
 
RELATED YEARS OF EXPERIENCE
Min of 10+ years of at least 5 years of experience in real estate, property and asset management, investment banking, buy side or sell side advisory or other related field.
 
YOE IN MANAGERIAL POSITION
Min of 2+ years in a related managerial position
 
FIELD OF EXPERIENCE
Banking, real estate consultancy, management consultancy.
 
TECHNICAL AND INTERPERSONAL SKILLS
Outstanding analytical and quantitative skills; proficiency with standard software, including MS Office; advanced Excel skills is a must.
Proven track record in conducting valuation / financial models.
Able to analyze, evaluate and move quickly to support rapid decision making.
Ability to interpret and manage transaction documentation: NDAs, MoUs, LoI’s, and SPA’s
Ability to develop Board level papers and investment memoranda.
 
QUALIFICATION
Bachelor Degree in Engineering, Economics, Finance or Accounting, MBA (Finance), CFA, CA or CPA preferred.

jobs.normalized_title: financial controller financial planning & analysis real estate
jobs.description:
Job Requisition ID: 181617 

 About Al-Futtaim
Established in the 1930s, Al-Futtaim is one of the most diversified and progressive privately held regional businesses, headquartered in Dubai. Operating across more than 20 countries, the Group spans automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and health. With more than 40,000 employees, Al-Futtaim represents over 200 of the world’s most recognised brands, including Toyota, Lexus, IKEA, ACE and Marks & Spencer. Driven by its purpose to enrich lives and elevate communities, Al-Futtaim focuses on digital innovation, AI, sustainable growth and strategic partnerships, creating long-term value for customers, communities and partners while building a responsible legacy for future generations.
 
 Overview Of The Role: 

 The Financial Controller, FP&A plays a key role in strengthening financial planning, performance management, and management reporting across the Real Estate Group, providing a consolidated regional view of business performance. The role partners closely with senior leadership, leveraging strong commercial acumen, macroeconomic insights, and real estate market knowledge to drive forward-looking analysis, forecasting, and strategic decision-making.

 A key focus is transforming FP&A through AI, automation, and advanced analytics, enhancing the quality, efficiency, and predictive value of financial planning and reporting. The successful candidate will bring a strong executive presence, excellent presentation skills, intellectual curiosity, and a proactive ownership mindset to generate actionable insights, improve financial visibility, and foster accountability across the organization.

 What You Will Do: 

 FP&A Leadership 

 Act as the central point of contact for FP&A activities across the Real Estate Group and relevant Group Finance requirements.

 Build trusted relationships across Finance and the business, using influence and appropriate escalation to drive alignment and timely delivery.

 Support the Head Of Finance in establishing strategic priorities and converting them into implementation plans.

 Budgeting, Forecasting and Strategic Planning 

 Lead and review individual and consolidated budgets, forecasts, and business plans across portfolios and geographies.

 Manage the end-to-end cycle, including timelines, templates, assumptions, and reviews.

 Challenge financial and operational assumptions with commercial knowledge and market intelligence.

 Utilize scenario, sensitivity, and predictive analysis to present potential outcomes and management responses.

 Performance Management and Insight 

 Lead monthly reviews of financial and operational performance against budget, ensuring variances are explained.

 Shift performance review focus from historical to predictive using rolling forecasts and leading indicators.

 Define and enhance relevant KPIs and leading indicators for each asset class.

 Assess macroeconomic and industry factors impacting performance and translate analysis into recommendations.

 Senior Leadership Reporting 

 Review Flash reports and commentaries, explaining events and requirements for future action.

 Prepare and present monthly financial performance decks to the Group CFO and senior leadership.

 Support various presentations, ensuring actions from reviews are addressed.

 Respond to urgent requests with appropriate judgement and coordination.

 FP&A Transformation and Technology 

 Champion the evolution of FP&A to a data-driven, insight-led function leveraging AI-powered tools.

 Identify opportunities for automation and advanced analytics in planning and reporting.

 Standardise templates, dashboards, and processes across portfolios.

 Promote adoption of new tools while ensuring data quality and governance.

 Governance and Performance Measurement 

 Ensure reporting and KPI frameworks are simple, measurable, and auditable.

 Act as contact for Group requirements, maintaining reporting quality and consistency.

 Coordinate responses to queries from Group Finance and other governance stakeholders.

 Required Skills To Be Successful: 

 Executive-level communication and presentation skills.

 Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills; competency with data visualization and planning tools.

 Strong commercial acumen and financial modeling capability.

 Ability to interpret macroeconomic and real estate industry trends into financial implications.

 What Qualifies You For The Role: 

 Professional Accounting/Finance qualification (CA, ACCA, CPA or equivalent); CFA or MBA is advantageous.

 Minimum of 12 years of relevant Finance experience, with at least 4 years in FP&A or a related function.

 Experience in Real Estate, Construction, Asset Management, or project-based industries strongly preferred.

 Proven ability to present financial results and recommendations to senior executives and manage complex stakeholder deliverables.

 About Al-Futtaim Real Estate

 With a legacy of more than six decades in real estate and asset management, Al-Futtaim Real Estate – part of Al-Futtaim – creates real impact on the communities it serves through long-term investment and growth. As one of the region’s leading private developers, the company plans, creates and manages developments across the MENA region. 

 Al-Futtaim Real Estate has a diversified, multi-billion-dollar portfolio across the real estate value chain and asset types such as residential, commercial, malls and industries including hospitality, healthcare, infrastructure and education. Flagship mixed-use urban communities include Dubai Festival City and Cairo Festival City. 

 Al-Futtaim Real Estate is also responsible for Al-Futtaim Contracting, a fully integrated, end-to-end specialist division operating across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar and Egypt. The business has delivered industry-leading construction, engineering, technology and FM solutions for more than 50 years.

 Job Description of Role

 Finance Operation 

 Lead end-to-end Month close as per the calendar ensure standalone books closing across group

 Ensure timely closure of Balance sheet and assurance across Group basis the calender

 Ensure timely and accurately reconciliation of Bank accounts 

 Ensure timely and accurately reconciliation of Inter company Balances and settle as per payment terms

 Finance Transformation & Strategy 

 Lead end-to-end finance transformation initiatives across Record-to-Report (R2R) & VAT 

 Support the design and execution of the Shared Services transformation roadmap.

 Identify opportunities for process standardization, simplification, and automation.

 Partner with Finance leadership to align transformation initiatives with business strategy.

 Process Optimization & Controls 

 Analyse current-state finance processes and design future-state operating models.

 Drive continuous improvement initiatives using Lean, Six Sigma, or similar methodologies.

 Strengthen internal controls, compliance, and governance across Shared Services.

 Ensure processes comply with accounting standards, SOX, and regulatory requirements.

 Digital Enablement & Automation 

 Lead or support implementation of finance systems (ERP, consolidation tools, workflow tools).

 Drive adoption of automation solutions including RPA, AI, and analytics.

 Partner with IT and vendors to deliver scalable and sustainable solutions.

 Change Management & Stakeholder Engagement 

 Act as a key liaison between Shared Services, Corporate Finance, and business stakeholders.

 Lead change management activities including communication, training, and adoption tracking.

GMG is a global well-being company retailing, distributing and manufacturing a portfolio of leading international and home-grown brands across sport, everyday goods, health and beauty, properties and logistics sectors. These include notable home-grown brands such as Sun & Sand Sports, Dropkick, Supercare Pharmacy, Farm Fresh, Klassic, and international brands like Nike, Columbia, Converse, Timberland, Vans, Mama Sita's, and McCain.

Role Summary:
The Senior Manager – Finance (Factory) is responsible for managing end-to-end finance operations at the factory level, ensuring robust financial control, accurate reporting, and operational finance support to manufacturing operations. The role is hands-on and execution-focused, acting as the key finance partner to Factory Operations while ensuring alignment with GMG’s Group finance policies, controls, and standards. The role covers core operational finance pillars, with a strong emphasis on compliance, efficiency, and cost discipline within a manufacturing environment.

Key Success Drivers including Accountabilities and Responsibilities:

1. Financial Control & Compliance

Ensure strict adherence to GMG Group finance policies, internal controls, and governance frameworks at the factory level

Maintain strong financial discipline across all manufacturing transactions, including inventory, procurement, and production costing

Lead and support internal and external audits, ensuring timely closure of audit findings and zero compliance gaps

Safeguard company assets through effective control mechanisms and regular reconciliations

2. Factory Financial Operations & Reporting

Oversee end-to-end factory finance operations, including month-end close, journal entries, and balance sheet reconciliations

Ensure timely, accurate, and insightful financial reporting aligned with Group timelines and standards

Monitor key financial metrics (cost per unit, yield, wastage, variances) and highlight risks and opportunities

Drive transparency and accuracy in inventory accounting and valuation

3. Cost Management & Efficiency

Track and control factory budgets, ensuring alignment with approved financial plans

Lead initiatives to improve productivity and reduce waste within the manufacturing process

4. Business Partnering with Factory Operations

People Management:

• Lead and develop the factory finance team.

• Allocate work, review outputs, and ensure high-quality deliverables.

• Build strong finance capability within the factory through coaching and on-the-job development.

• Promote a culture of accountability, discipline, and continuous improvement.

 By upholding our values of respect, excellence, collaboration and integrity; Al-Futtaim Group continues to enrich the lives and aspirations of our customers each and every day

 Overview of the role 
We are currently looking for a Manager FP&A to join our Finance team in Jebel Ali. The role will support the business through robust financial planning, management reporting, MIS, budgeting, forecasting, feasibility studies and commercial analysis. This position works closely with Finance, Operations, Sales, HR and senior management to provide accurate insights, identify trends, support decision-making and ensure strong financial governance across the business.

• Prepare ad hoc analysis, reports and presentations as required by management.

 Required skills to be successful

• Minimum 5-8 years of experience in Finance, including at least 3 years in commercial finance and/or operational support.
• Experience in budgeting, forecasting, MIS reporting, variance analysis and business performance reviews. Strong financial analysis, costing analysis, ratio analysis and KPI reporting skills.
• Good understanding of VAT, tax compliance, audit support and financial governance requirements.

 About the team 
You will be part of the Finance team, working closely with operational and commercial stakeholders to support business performance, financial control and informed decision-making. Driven by its purpose to enrich lives and elevate communities, Al-Futtaim focuses on digital innovation, AI, sustainable growth and strategic partnerships, creating long-term value for customers, communities and partners while building a responsible legacy for future generations.
 
 Overview Of The Role: 

 The Commercial Manager oversees the full commercial lifecycle of assigned real estate development projects, ensuring commercial control, timely procurement, and adherence to budgets and governance requirements. This role collaborates closely with development, design, project management, and finance teams along with external consultants and contractors, to ensure value-for-money solutions that protect the commercial interests of the business. The Commercial Manager is vital in supporting project success through robust procurement strategies, effective risk management, and detailed commercial reporting.

 What You Will Do: 

 Pre-Contract Commercial Management 

 Prepare feasibility-level and pre-concept cost estimates to support early development decisions.

 Review, challenge, and validate estimates, cost plans, and budgets produced by external cost consultants.

 Develop and maintain project cost benchmarks using relevant market and historical project data.

 Provide commercial input throughout concept and design development, including advice on cost risks, opportunities, and budget implications.

 Lead value engineering exercises and evaluate alternative design, specification, procurement, and construction solutions without compromising the required quality or functionality.

 Formulate project-specific procurement strategies, including contract packaging, procurement routes, tender sequencing, market engagement, and recommended forms of contract.

 Support business cases and stage-gate reviews with clear commercial analysis.

 Procurement and Tendering 

 Manage end-to-end procurement of professional consultancy services, including design, project management, cost consultancy, supervision, and specialist advisory appointments.

 Manage tendering of construction works, including enabling works, infrastructure, main works, fit-out, specialist packages, and other project-specific scopes.

 Prepare and coordinate tender documentation, commercial schedules, pricing requirements, bid instructions, and evaluation criteria.

 Perform detailed commercial evaluations, bid normalization, clarifications, and tender negotiations.

 Prepare clear tender evaluation reports, award recommendations, approval memoranda, and contract documentation.

 Ensure procurement activities are competitive, transparent, auditable, and compliant with company governance and delegated authority requirements.

 Streamline procurement processes through improved workflows, standardized templates, clear accountability, and disciplined tender planning.

 Monitor procurement schedules and proactively address issues that may affect project milestones.

 Post-Contract Commercial Management 

 Maintain effective commercial and contractual control throughout project delivery.

 Review and assess interim payment applications and support timely certification and payment processing.

 Monitor approved budgets, commitments, expenditure, forecasts, contingency usage, and projected final cost.

 Manage variations and change control from initiation through evaluation, negotiation, approval, and incorporation into the project forecast.

 Assess contractual notices, prolongation costs, extension-of-time submissions, disruption claims, and other contractor or consultant claims.

Job Requisition ID: 181516 

 About Al-Futtaim
Established in the 1930s, Al-Futtaim is one of the most diversified and progressive privately held regional businesses, headquartered in Dubai. Operating across more than 20 countries, the Group spans automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and health. With more than 40,000 employees, Al-Futtaim represents over 200 of the world’s most recognised brands, including Toyota, Lexus, IKEA, ACE and Marks & Spencer. Driven by its purpose to enrich lives and elevate communities, Al-Futtaim focuses on digital innovation, AI, sustainable growth and strategic partnerships, creating long-term value for customers, communities and partners while building a responsible legacy for future generations.
 
 Overview Of The Role: 

 The Operational/Financial Audit Manager is responsible for planning, directing, and overseeing the audit activities to mitigate risks and ensure compliance with organizational policies and procedures. This role involves managing a team of auditors, supervising audit engagements, presenting audit findings, and recommending improvements to the company's control and governance system. Success in this role requires strong leadership and analytical skills, an ability to manage resources effectively, and a commitment to continuous improvement of audit processes.

 What You Will Do: 

 Audit Planning and Execution 
 
 Plan, direct, and monitor audit activities to minimize risks and ensure compliance with established company policies.

 Apply the organization’s audit methodology and execute audit procedures to meet specific engagement objectives.

 Supervise audit engagements to confirm that the scope of work is adequate, objectives are achieved, and quality is maintained.

 Develop, implement, and monitor audit project plans to ensure timely delivery according to agreed timelines.

 Present findings and suggest recommendations addressing root causes and organizational impacts.

 Follow up with management to ensure the implementation of recommended actions.

 Support and Assurance 
 
 Assist the line manager in recommending improvements to the controls and governance of financial, operational, and managerial processes and IT systems.

 Provide reasonable assurance that the organization adheres to established company policies and procedures.

 Offer consulting and advisory services that enhance business processes and compliance.

 Team Management 
 
 Manage resources efficiently to achieve engagement objectives and optimize team performance.

 Provide timely feedback and support to staff to achieve their professional development goals.

 Encourage quality and excellence while fostering an environment for continuous development among the audit staff.

 Delegate tasks constructively and supportively, ensuring responsibilities are clear and manageable.

 Global Internal Audit Standards & Quality 
 
 Support implementation and ongoing conformance with the IIA Global Internal Audit Standards and applicable IPPF requirements across the internal audit function. 

 Apply a risk-based approach to audit planning and engagements, supporting the development and dynamic revision of the annual/quarterly audit plan in response to changes in organizational risks and priorities. 

 Support the Quality Assurance and Improvement Program (QAIP) , including internal assessments, performance monitoring and continuous improvement of the internal audit function. 

 Contribute to the implementation of applicable IIA Topical Requirements and maintain appropriate evidence of conformance with the Standards. 

 Promote continuous improvement in audit methodology, use of technology, data analytics and overall audit effectiveness. 

 Internal Audit Delivery 
 
 Ensure optimal delivery of internal audits according to the approved plan for assigned geographies/sub-clusters.

 Prepare informative and concise audit reports that meet professional standards.

 Identify and address resource needs and limitations in collaboration with the line manager.

 Maintain competencies necessary for effective audit delivery and ensure audits are quality assured and timely.

 Data Analytics and AI 
 
 Design analytics tests to support audit activities and leverage data analysis techniques to support audit conclusions.

 Extend audit coverage using data analytics and AI tools, such as Advanced Excel, Power BI, and others.

 Identify new data sources for audits and continuous monitoring, enhancing the audit function's reach and accuracy.

 Required Skills To Be Successful: 

 Proficiency in audit methodologies and risk management.

 Strong leadership and team management capabilities.

 Advanced skills in data analysis and the use of AI tools.

 Exceptional oral and written communication skills.

 What Qualifies You For The Role: 

 Professionally Qualified Chartered Accountant or equivalent.

 Minimum 10 years in operational and financial audits, including at least 2-3 years in a managerial role.

 Internal audit exposure in the automotive sector.

 Strong analytical skills, excellent communication abilities, and familiarity with computerized financial/operational systems (SAP S4 Hana – VSS preferred)

With us, you will turn your aspirations into reality.  We will help shape your journey through enriching experiences, learning and development opportunities and exposure to different assignments within your role or through internal mobility. We Invite All Applicants to Apply

It Takes Diversity Of Thought, Culture, Background, Differing Abilities and Perspectives to truly Inspire, Exhilarate and Delight our customers. At Chalhoub Group, we are committed to inclusion and diversity.

We welcome all applicants to apply and be part of our exciting future. We ensure equal opportunity for all our applicants without regard to gender, age, race, religion, national origin or disability status.

jobs.title: Manager - Finance
jobs.description:
The position serves as a strategic business partner to the leadership team and is accountable for ensuring the integrity of financial reporting, effective cash flow management, budgeting and forecasting, financial controls, compliance, business performance analysis, and operational finance excellence. The role is responsible for driving financial performance, safeguarding company assets, optimizing working capital, improving profitability, and supporting business growth through robust financial planning and informed decision-making. The Finance Manager will oversee General Ledger, Accounts Receivable, Revenue Accounting, Treasury Coordination, Statutory Compliance, and Finance Transformation initiatives while ensuring seamless integration between Sales force Property Management CRM and Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance (D365).
 Lead the annual budgeting process, rolling forecasts, long-range financial plans, and cash flow management across all business units and properties.
 Monitor financial performance against budgets and forecasts, providing actionable insights and recommendations to improve results.
 Establish and oversee financial KPIs, profitability analysis, and performance measurement frameworks across assets, business units, tenants, and service lines.
 Drive monthly business performance reviews and support operational leaders in achieving financial and commercial objectives.
 Ensure strong financial governance, compliance with IFRS, UAE VAT, UAE Corporate Tax, and adherence to internal policies and approval frameworks.
 Develop and maintain robust internal controls, risk management processes, and audit readiness across all finance functions.
 Lead finance transformation initiatives, including ERP optimization, process automation, digitalization, and system integration projects.
 Enhance decision-making through financial analytics, dashboards, business intelligence tools, and continuous process improvement initiatives.
 Sponsor and oversee key finance technology projects, including Microsoft Dynamics 365, Salesforce integration, UAT, and system enhancements.
 Foster a high-performance finance culture by driving accountability, operational excellence, and continuous improvement across the organization.
 Lead financial accounting operations, ensuring the integrity of financial records, general ledger management, balance sheet reconciliations, fixed assets, intercompany transactions, and timely period-end closings.
 Oversee the preparation of management accounts, statutory financial statements, board reports, and business performance analysis, providing accurate and actionable financial insights.
 Manage revenue accounting and accounts receivable functions, including billing, collections, tenant credit risk, aging reviews, revenue recognition, and working capital optimization.
 Oversee treasury operations, cash flow forecasting, liquidity management, banking relationships, funding requirements, and compliance with financing arrangements.
 Ensure compliance with IFRS, UAE VAT, UAE Corporate Tax, regulatory requirements, and internal policies, while supporting tax planning and audit activities.
 Lead internal, external and FTA audits, coordinate audit engagements, implement corrective actions, and maintain a strong control environment and audit readiness across the organization
 Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, or related discipline.
 ACCA, CA, CPA, CMA, or equivalent professional qualification preferred.
 IFRS, UAE Corporate Tax and VAT Compliance
 Financial Accounting, Consolidation & Reporting
 Treasury, Cash Flow & Working Capital Management
 Internal Controls, Risk Management & Audit
 Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance, Sales Force, Hyperion, Power BI and Power Query

Established in the 1930s, Al-Futtaim is one of the most diversified and progressive privately held regional businesses, headquartered in Dubai.  Deliver reports that conform to group policies and long-term goals.

Our brands include Bloomingdales, Harvey Nichols and Armani to name just a few!

To manage & monitor the inventory and stock holdings ensuring system stock issues are minimized. Monitor and control movement of stock, formulate policies and control procedures in order to maintain minimum discrepancies. Ensure all returns to suppliers are managed & monitored.
 Strategic Roles and Responsibilities 
 Custodian of Business inventory and responsible for overall inventory management operations.
 Responsible for warehouse storage space optimization, ABC analysis, heat map analysis and implementation
 Implement stock loss action plans (formulated as a result of cycle counts/stock counts) in conjunction with Loss Prevention Team
 Review and monitor extent of damages in the WH and come up with action plan to mitigate the occurrence in conjunction with warehouse inbound and outbound operations
 Execution on WH shrinkage analysis and reductions.
 Ensure timeliness & integrity of all inventory transaction
 
 Functional Roles and Responsibilities 
 Conduct investigation of inventory discrepancies identified during cycle count or picking and take action to rectify the discrepancies within the timelines.
 Oversee the entire process of stock transfers inter warehouse, warehouse to store and store to warehouse, ensure the movements are recorded and updated to reduce discrepancies.
 Provide regular update on pending transfers, WH cycle counts & transparency of trouble coded inventory
 Directly coordinate with suppliers and buying for returning the intended stocks
 Tracking on all WH logs, credit note, RTV adjustments and submit to FSS
 Pass the CN, RTV, Write-off and general adjustment thru system and report to finance.
 Monitor transactions daily, investigating discrepancies and confirming On-base logs are raised. Also reviewing the status of logs to ensure accurate resolution.
 Manage perpetual stock take calendar in conjunction with designated managers and stock take team, communicate the plan, and ensure compliance to the plan.
 Liaise with business inventory managers for monthly shrinkage data and prepare/share the final report.
 Manage the expiry product identification and share the visibility reports with all stakeholders.
 Manage the disposal or RTV of expired and obsolete goods at respective warehouse to ensure high quality standards are maintained in the activities of the Company. 
 Oversee the physical stock count process, review stock count results in conjunction with the management and reconcile the figures by auditing physical stock movements.
 Prepare reports based on the findings and provide recommendations and suggestions to the management
 
 People Management Roles and Responsibilities 
 Coach and motivate reportees to enhance performance and produce quality standards and outputs, ensure that they are continuously developed and provided feedback.
 Review Operational processes from a risk management perspective; identify and qualify new areas of risks and escalate concerns to the site HSE committee.
 Guide and motivate subordinates to enhance performance and produce quality work, and ensure that they are continuously developed for higher level roles.

 Regularly communicate to the team on operational performance and brief on upcoming events
 Create a positive work environment that results in low attrition, sickness and absence reduction to ensure that Collective and individual targets are met
 
 Education/Certification and Continued Education 
 Graduate with excellent knowledge of warehousing & inventory management
 
 Years of Experience 
 3-5 years of experience in warehousing & inventory management with knowledge in ecommerce retail environment
 
 Knowledge and Skills 
 Computer Literacy and excellent MS excel skills 
 Highly organized with eye for details
 Preferably Good knowledge in Oracle - WMS 
 Strong Communication and Interpersonal skills 
 Good analytical skills
 
 Languages 
 English

knowledge of accounting standards, tax laws and regulations.

Exceptional analytical and problem-solving abilities.
 
Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
 
Effective team player with the capacity to manage multiple projects concurrently.
 
 
QUALIFICATION
 
Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance.

 The Supplier & Cost Management Specialist - Technology is responsible for driving technology spend governance, supplier performance management, commercial evaluation, and cost optimization across the Digital Technology & Innovation portfolio. Acting as a key partner to Technology, Finance, Procurement, and Business stakeholders, the role ensures cost transparency, maximizes value from technology investments, and delivers sustainable savings through effective financial control, commercial management, and strategic supplier engagement.  Drive end-to-end visibility and governance of technology expenditure across software, cloud, infrastructure, telecom, managed services, and professional services portfolios.

Synopsis
 As Product Specialist – Cargo Digital Systems, you will support the delivery, enhancement, and day-to-day evolution of Etihad Cargo’s digital platforms and commercial systems ecosystem, with a strong focus on the Cargo Booking Website, API integrations, and internally developed digital applications.
 You will work closely with Product Owners, Cargo business stakeholders, DT&I, vendors, and development teams to gather requirements, define solutions, coordinate deliveries, perform testing activities, and support continuous product improvements.
 The role combines product analysis, business process understanding, technical coordination, and hands-on support for digital product development initiatives. You will contribute to Agile product delivery while supporting the development and enhancement of web applications built primarily using JavaScript and React technologies.
 This role is ideal for candidates with strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities who are interested in developing broader technical, digital product, and application development skills.
 Accountabilities
 • Prioritize and coordinate the delivery of bug fixes, enhancements, and new releases for Cargo systems in collaboration with DT&I and Cargo stakeholders across Commercial and Operations.

• Support the delivery of enhancements, fixes, integrations, and new features across Etihad Cargo digital platforms and Cargo systems.

• Act as a key contributor for the Etihad Cargo Booking Website, supporting feature enhancements, business requirements gathering, testing activities, and coordination with vendors and developers.

• Support integration projects between Cargo systems, customer platforms, and third-party applications.

• Assist in the design, coordination, and delivery of small internal applications, automation tools, and operational support solutions.

• Gather and document business requirements from Commercial, Revenue Management, Pricing, Sales, Operations, Customs, and Ground Handling stakeholders.

• Translate business requirements into user stories, functional specifications, acceptance criteria, and process flows.

• Support backlog refinement, sprint planning, demos, and retrospectives.

• Coordinate closely with DT&I teams, vendors, and developers to ensure requirements and priorities are clearly understood.

• Perform User Acceptance Testing (UAT), regression testing, and validation of delivered functionalities.

• Track defects, support issue analysis, and coordinate resolution activities with vendors and technical teams.

• Support monitoring of product usage, operational KPIs, and user feedback to identify improvement opportunities.

• Contribute to UX improvements by supporting the design of intuitive and efficient user workflows.

• Support lightweight technical activities such as data analysis, API testing, configuration validation, and basic scripting/automation initiatives.

• Assist in maintaining documentation including release notes, process documentation, test scenarios, and knowledge articles.

• Ensure solutions comply with Etihad standards related to security, governance, and operational reliability.

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or related discipline.

• Minimum 3 years of experience in product analysis, digital products, system support, or business systems environments, preferably within cargo, aviation, logistics, or e-commerce industries.

• Good understanding of Agile methodologies such as Scrum or SAFe.

• Familiarity with web technologies such as JavaScript, React, APIs, JSON, or modern web applications is preferred.

• Experience supporting digital platforms, customer portals, or API integrations is an advantage.

• Experience in User Acceptance Testing (UAT), defect management, and release coordination.

• Basic knowledge of SQL, Python, Power BI, or automation tools is advantageous.

• Strong analytical thinking and structured problem-solving skills.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder coordination abilities.

• Ability to work across business and technical teams in a collaborative environment.

Join us and become part of a vision where the world is your workplace and extraordinary experiences take flight.

Beware of fraudulent job offers from individuals or organizations claiming to represent the Etihad group. If you are asked for money, please treat it as fraudulent.

jobs.description:
Job Requisition ID: 181905 

 About Al-Futtaim
Established in the 1930s, Al-Futtaim is one of the most diversified and progressive privately held regional businesses, headquartered in Dubai. Operating across more than 20 countries, the Group spans automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and health. With more than 40,000 employees, Al-Futtaim represents over 200 of the world’s most recognised brands, including Toyota, Lexus, IKEA, ACE and Marks & Spencer. Driven by its purpose to enrich lives and elevate communities, Al-Futtaim focuses on digital innovation, AI, sustainable growth and strategic partnerships, creating long-term value for customers, communities and partners while building a responsible legacy for future generations.
 
 Overview Of The Role: 

 The Director – Resi Comm+ is responsible for leading the strategic and operational performance of Al-Futtaim Real Estate’s residential and commercial portfolio, driving asset value growth, revenue optimization, and tenant satisfaction. The role oversees asset management, leasing, tenant mix, service charge governance, and capital improvement initiatives while ensuring sustainable financial performance and effective stakeholder management across the portfolio.

 What You Will Do: 

 Strategic Asset Management & Portfolio Planning 

 Develop and execute asset strategies tailored to DFC and AFRE's residential and commercial assets, aligned with long-term financial goals and investment mandates.

 Drive annual business planning processes, performance benchmarking, and asset repositioning strategies across all asset classes.

 Increase in Net Operating Income (NOI).

 Delivery of approved annual and 5-year asset plans.

 Asset valuation growth based on external and internal benchmarking.

 P&L Accountability 

 Manage the full profit and loss statement of each residential and commercial asset, including income, cost controls, service recovery, and profitability tracking.

 Drive the creation of asset-level budgets, forecasts, and capital expenditure plans in collaboration with Finance.

 Ensure budget compliance and variance control.

 Meet or exceed revenue targets across the portfolio.

 Timely and accurate reporting of monthly and quarterly financials.

 Residential & Commercial Leasing Strategy 

 Lead commercial leasing initiatives across retail and office segments in DFC and ARE projects, ensuring optimal occupancy, market-aligned rents, and long-term tenant satisfaction.

 Define and monitor the residential leasing and sales strategy with a focus on tenant retention, unit absorption, and product-market alignment.

 Maintain high occupancy rates by asset and segment.

 Achieve renewal success rates and churn reduction.

 Optimize average rental yield and tenant mix.

 Tenant Relationship & Community Management 

 Serve as a senior point of contact for VIP tenants and commercial lease partners.

 Establish and act upon tenant feedback loops to support tenant retention and service excellence.

 Achieve high tenant satisfaction and net promoter scores (NPS).

 Resolve tenant issues within agreed service level agreements (SLAs).

 Secure long-term lease renewals of strategic tenants.

 Property and Facilities Management Oversight 

 Oversee the performance of in-house and outsourced facilities management teams, ensuring assets meet operational KPIs, health and safety standards, and maintenance SLAs.

 Align operational services with asset class needs, tenant expectations, and cost-efficiency mandates.

 Ensure AMC contract compliance and SLA delivery.

 Monitor downtime metrics for critical systems such as HVAC and elevators.

 Enhance service issue resolution and preventive maintenance scores.

 Capital Projects, Lifecycle Planning & ROI Management 

 Lead planning and execution of major capital improvements, refurbishments, and lifecycle upgrades across all properties.

 Prepare business cases for Capex approval, tracking performance through KPIs and ROI metrics.

 Ensure timely and on-budget delivery of capital projects.

 Achieve positive ROI on Capex investments.

 Improve building quality and asset competitiveness.

 Service Charge Structuring, Recovery & Transparency 

 Oversee the development and auditing of service charge budgets in coordination with Finance and FM, ensuring transparency and recoverability.

 Ensure compliance with RERA and relevant strata management regulations.

 Achieve high annual service charge recovery rates.

 Maintain audit compliance and reconciliation timelines.

 Enhance tenant satisfaction with cost transparency.

 Market Intelligence & Competitive Benchmarking 

 Monitor real estate market trends, competitor positioning, and regulatory changes to inform pricing, leasing, and asset repositioning decisions.

 Actively engage with brokers, research agencies, and industry events.

 Ensure market-aligned pricing and product positioning.

 Benchmark performance against peer assets.

 Develop updated strategic responses to regulatory or market shifts.

 Team Leadership & People Development 

 Provide strategic direction and leadership to the asset management team responsible for residential and commercial properties across Dubai Festival City and AFRE’s broader portfolio.

 Guide, mentor, and develop high-performing professionals including property managers, leasing specialists, and analysts.

 Ensure alignment with organizational goals and foster a culture of performance, accountability, and collaboration.

 Lead by example in cross-functional coordination with Finance, Legal, Facilities Management, and Development teams.

 Achieve effective cross-functional collaboration and project delivery outcomes.

 Required Skills To Be Successful: 

 Strategic financial and commercial acumen with P&L accountability.

 Strong leadership and stakeholder engagement skills.

 Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and manage multiple assets.

 Sound understanding of leasing, FM operations, and capital planning.

 What Qualifies You For The Role: 

 Bachelor’s degree in Real Estate, Finance, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field.

 Master’s degree (MBA or MSc in Real Estate or Asset Management) preferred.

 20+ years of experience in asset and property management, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role managing large mixed-use portfolios.

 Proven record of managing income-producing residential and commercial real estate assets.

 Strong exposure to the UAE or GCC market essential.

 Experience in design input, lease structuring, and service charge governance.

 Experience in freehold properties advantageous.

 About Al-Futtaim Real Estate

 With a legacy of more than six decades in real estate and asset management, Al-Futtaim Real Estate – part of Al-Futtaim – creates real impact on the communities it serves through long-term investment and growth. As one of the region’s leading private developers, the company plans, creates and manages developments across the MENA region. 

 Al-Futtaim Real Estate has a diversified, multi-billion-dollar portfolio across the real estate value chain and asset types such as residential, commercial, malls and industries including hospitality, healthcare, infrastructure and education. Flagship mixed-use urban communities include Dubai Festival City and Cairo Festival City. 

 Al-Futtaim Real Estate is also responsible for Al-Futtaim Contracting, a fully integrated, end-to-end specialist division operating across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar and Egypt. The business has delivered industry-leading construction, engineering, technology and FM solutions for more than 50 years.

Support the timely and accurate financial close, consolidation and reporting of multiple entities and ledgers in accordance with IFRS and Group requirements
 
Assist in maintaining financial data and general ledger integrity, including reconciliations, financial statements and audit requirements
 
Support the use of AI-enabled and digital finance tools to improve reporting efficiency, accuracy and financial analysis

Group Consolidation & Financial Reporting
Support monthly, quarterly and annual Group consolidation and financial reporting
 
Assist with reporting submissions, account mapping, intercompany eliminations and Group-level adjustments
 
Prepare consolidation schedules, reconciliations and supporting documentation
 
Coordinate with subsidiaries and finance teams for accurate, timely information

Follow up on outstanding reconciliation items and support timely resolution
 
Assist in maintaining accurate financial records and supporting documentation
 
Support compliance with Group policies, internal controls and reporting procedures

Audit & Compliance

Financial Analysis & Management Reporting

AI, Digital & Process Improvement

FIELD OF EXPERIENCE
Experience of accounting within real estate or related industry is preferred

Good knowledge of financial accounting, IFRS and financial reporting principles.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with accuracy and attention to detail.
 
Working knowledge of AI-enabled and digital finance tools for analysis, reporting and process efficiency
 
Good communication, stakeholder coordination and time-management skills.
 
 
QUALIFICATION
 
Bachelor’s degree in accounting
 
Professional accounting qualification e.g., CPA, CIMA, CA, ACCA  is preferred

 Tax Data Management & Data Quality

 Digital & AI-Enabled Automation of Tax Processes

 Develop, test, and deploy solutions using Python, Power Platform, RPA, and approved AI/agent tooling.

For over seven decades, Chalhoub Group has been a partner and creator of luxury experiences in the Middle East. Every step at Chalhoub Group is taken to build a future where luxury dreams become reality — bridging cultures and crafting memorable experiences for our consumers. Be it by constantly reinventing itself, committing to innovation, or embracing new technologies, the Group is shaping the future of luxury retail. It delivers seamless omnichannel experiences across more than 950 stores, online platforms, and mobile apps. Driving this innovation journey is The Greenhouse — the Group’s innovation hub, incubator, and accelerator for startups and emerging businesses, regionally and globally.

Chalhoub Group fosters a people-at-heart culture rooted in diversity, equity, and inclusion, and a workplace catalysed by forward thinking and future-proofing. Today, it brings together over 16,000 talented professionals across eight countries in the Middle East, with a presence in LATAM.

Sustainability is at the core of the Group’s strategy, guided by a clear commitment to people, partners, and the planet. Chalhoub Group is proud to be a member of the United Nations Global Compact, a signatory of the Women’s Empowerment Principles, and to have pledged to reach Net Zero by 2040.

About the Role

As a Senior Tax Associate within our Group Tax team in Dubai, you will own the Pillar Two (GloBE) compliance programme and support across our wider Middle East direct tax obligations.

This is a hands-on technical role at the center of one of the most significant changes in international tax in decades. You will be building our tax compliance framework as the rules themselves mature moving from first-year registrations and transitional safe harbours through to full GloBE Information Return (GIR) and local return filings.

What you'll be doing

Pillar Two (DMTT, IIR and UTPR) compliance and reporting

  • Handling group-level Pillar Two compliance and reporting requirements for in-scope entities, against applicable statutory deadlines.

  • Maintain the Pillar Two group structure, including identifying and classifying legal entities (Constituent Entities, Excluded Entities, JVs, etc).

  • Prepare Transitional CbCR Safe Harbour calculations and assess, jurisdiction by jurisdiction, where safe harbours apply and where full ETR computations are required.

  • Perform detailed Pillar Two calculations for applicable countries i.e. GloBE Income or Loss, Adjusted Covered Taxes, ETR, Substance-based Income Exclusion, de minimis exclusion and Top-up Tax allocation.

  • Own the data lifecycle: collect, structure and validate the financial, tax and entity data required for filings, coordinating with Group Reporting, Finance Shared Services, FP&A and in-country finance teams.

  • Prepare the GloBE Information Return and where applicable, local DMTT and IIR returns.

  • Monitor Pillar Two registrations and notifications as further jurisdictions enact rules.

  • Prepare Pillar Two tax provision calculations for both actuals and budget / forecast cycles, and support the related IAS 12 disclosures.

  • Maintain and update the group's Pillar Two position paper, documenting technical positions, elections and judgements taken.

  • Maintain a compliance calendar tracking obligations and due dates across all relevant jurisdictions, with clear status reporting to management.

Regional direct tax compliance support

  • Manage tax compliance in Kuwait, including the preparation and submission of applications for tax clearance certificates and providing support on tax retention requirements in line with local regulations.

  • Support with corporate income tax and withholding tax filings in Qatar as required, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and adherence to applicable legislation.

  • Lead correspondence and engagement with tax authorities in the region to resolve issues, initiate applications and follow up on outstanding matters through to resolution.

Advisory, governance and stakeholder management

  • Monitor OECD releases and local legislative developments across the group's footprint, and translate them into practical impact assessments for the business.

  • Support tax authority queries, information requests and audits in relation to Pillar Two and the compliance areas above.

  • Identify opportunities to automate and strengthen controls over Pillar Two data collection and calculation.

What you’ll need to succeed :

  • You are ACA / ACCA / CPA / CA / ADIT (or equivalent) qualified.

  • You hold a Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Tax, Law or Economics.

  • You possess 2–3 years of relevant Pillar Two or corporate tax experience, gained in Consulting / inhouse tax role, or a combination of both.

  • You have a demonstrable, hands-on Pillar Two experience for example safe harbour analysis, ETR and top-up tax modelling, entity classification, data collection, registrations, or GIR/DMTT return preparation.

  • You have a working command of the OECD GloBE framework: Model Rules, Commentary, Administrative Guidance, the Safe Harbours and Penalty Relief guidance, and the GIR.

  • You possess strong Excel and data-handling skills, with the ability to build, document and sanity-check complex multi-entity calculations.

  • You are an excellent English communicator.

  • You possess strong attention to detail, a documentation-first mindset, and the organizational discipline to manage multiple statutory deadlines across jurisdictions.

  • You are comfortable operating with incomplete information in an evolving regulatory area, and confident raising issues early.

Preferred Skills

  • Solid grounding in corporate income tax and in the interaction between tax and financial reporting (IFRS, IAS

The Assistant Manager - Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) is responsible for overseeing financial analysis, budgeting, forecasting, and MIS reporting to support strategic decision-making and enhance financial performance. This role involves analyzing financial data, ensuring data integrity, optimizing budgeting processes, and providing key financial insights to management. The position also plays a crucial role in cost control, risk assessment, and compliance with financial regulations to drive the organization’s profitability and long-term growth.
 
 KEY RESPONSIBILITY 
 Financial Planning & Analysis:
 • Conduct financial analysis and reporting to identify trends, variances, and performance metrics, providing actionable insights for management.
 • Assist in the development of annual budgets, quarterly forecasts, and long-term financial projections to align with business objectives.
 • Perform variance analysis, comparing actual financial results against budgets and forecasts, and recommend corrective actions.
 • Support cost analysis and profitability assessments to drive cost-saving initiatives and process optimization.
 
 Management Reporting & Data Analysis: 
 • Prepare and present accurate MIS reports, including store-wise Profit & Loss (P&L) statements, Balance Sheets, and other financial reports.

 • Assist in managing insurance processes for retail outlets, assets, warehouses, and offices.
 
 Budgeting & Forecasting:

 • Develop and maintain financial models to support business decisions, investment planning, and risk management.
 • Support the monthly reconciliation of intercompany transactions and accounts to ensure financial integrity.
 
 Compliance & Risk Management:

 • Assist in audit processes and internal financial assessments to maintain accuracy and transparency.
 DESIRED EXPERIENCE 
 The ideal Assistant Manager – Financial Planning & Analysis should have 5-7 years of experience in Management Information Systems (MIS) or IT management, with experience in a leadership role.

 Strong analytical, problem-solving, and project management skills.
 KEY RELATIONSHIPS 
 Manager – Financial Planning & Analysis, Business Teams, Functional departments, Executive - MIS & Business Analyst, Manager - Accounts and Finance, Treasury Operations Team, Purchase Team, Manager - Tax, etc.

 About Al-Futtaim 

 Established in the 1930s, Al-Futtaim is one of the most diversified and progressive privately held regional businesses, headquartered in Dubai.  Job Role: 

 We are currently seeking an AML Analyst to join our Insurance Division. 

 The AML Analyst is responsible for assisting the Compliance Department in establishing and implementing internal procedures related to Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Counter-Terrorist Financing (CTF), Counter-Proliferation Financing (CPF), Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act (FATCA), and Common Reporting Standard (CRS). The role supports the Compliance Department in ensuring that an appropriate framework, governance structure, and controls are in place to maintain compliance across the Insurance Division in line with applicable AML, CTF, CPF, FATCA & CRS regulatory requirements. 

 Job Responsibilities: 

 Assist the Compliance Department in the development and implementation of AML, CTF, CPF, FATCA, and CRS policies and procedures. 

 Regularly coordinate and follow up with internal departments to obtain required due diligence documents. 

 Execute due diligence activities in accordance with defined processes and applicable regulatory guidelines. 

 Complete enterprise-wide risk assessments and client risk assessments in accordance with established procedures and regulatory requirements. 

 Track and manage relevant documentation in accordance with the record retention policy. 

 Ensure all reporting timelines are met in accordance with agreed Turnaround Times (TATs). 

 Support the screening and transaction monitoring systems review and implementation. 

 Identify red flags and control issues relating to KYC and client onboarding. 

 Conduct investigations and prepare Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs) and Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs). 

 Liaise with regulators and supervisors in connection with the AML, CTF, CPF, FATCA, CRS program and related regulatory matters. 

 Build strong partnerships with Internal Audit, Operations, Business Development, and other stakeholders in connection with the AML, CTF, CPF, FATCA, and CRS programs. 

 Work with leaders across the organization to address and resolve related open issues in a timely and effective manner. 

 Seek AML, CTF, CPF, FATCA, and CRS compliance advice from the Compliance Committee, and organize and participate in Compliance Committee meetings. 

 Ensure the timely filing of regulatory reports with the relevant regulator. 

 Develop training presentations and conduct training relating to AML, CTF, CPF, FATCA, and CRS. 

 Assist in the planning and execution of AML, CTF, CPF, FATCA, and CRS compliance reviews, including the analysis of results. 

 Work with business lines during testing to understand control processes and identify action plans to address control deficiencies. 

 Communicate with various levels of management to ensure compliance with applicable regulatory and internal requirements. 

 Maintain ongoing awareness and current knowledge of all applicable internal and external AML, CTF, CPF, FATCA, and CRS regulatory requirements, and identify any issues that could impact the Institution. 

 Review high-risk relationships, particularly cases escalated to Senior Management, and ensure that all relevant risks are appropriately highlighted for management sign-off. 

 Job Requirements: 

 Minimum of 3 years of AML, CTF, CPF, FATCA, and CRS compliance experience in the banking, insurance, or related industries. 

 Bachelor’s degree in finance, Law, Commerce, or Business Administration. 

 Language Skills: Excellent oral and written English communication skills. 

 Excellent organizational skills, with the ability to prioritize workload, demonstrate resilience, and work effectively under pressure. 

 Excellent interpersonal skills, with the ability to communicate confidently with various levels of management. 

 Strong AML, CTF, CPF, FATCA, and CRS analytical skills, with a good knowledge and understanding of industry best practices, internal controls, and regulatory requirements. 

 Knowledge of transaction monitoring systems and screening tools. 

 Knowledge of applicable laws, decisions, resolutions, guidelines, and regulatory requirements relating to AML, CTF, CPF, FATCA, and CRS. 

 About Orient Insurance PJSC 

 Orient Insurance Company commenced operations in 1982 as a part of the reputed Al-Futtaim Group and has since recorded a progressively steady growth. The Company is counted among the leaders in the UAE insurance market. Orient Insurance Company has a paid-up capital of AED 500 Million which is the highest in the insurance industry in UAE. With head office in Dubai, the company serves its clientele through an extensive branch network in Jebel Ali, Abu Dhabi, Al Ain, Sharjah and Ras Al Khaimah in UAE, Muscat in Sultanate of Oman, Riyadh in Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and Bahrain.

jobs.title: Sales Representative - Corporate Accounts
jobs.description:
About this role: 
 Etihad Airways is looking for a Sales Representative to own and grow a portfolio of corporate accounts across the UAE. You'll be the face of Etihad to our corporate clients, building relationships, spotting revenue opportunities, and negotiating agreements that work for both sides. This role is built for someone who already knows how corporate travel accounts work: aviation industry experience is essential, and prior B2B corporate accounts sales experience is a must.
 Accountabilities: 
 Own a portfolio of corporate accounts plan and execute sales activity using market data and insights from Sales Strategy & Planning to hit targets.
 Analyse market potential across existing and prospective corporate clients, converting opportunities into revenue.
 Build trusted, long-term relationships with corporate accounts, positioning yourself as their go-to advisor for travel solutions.
 Negotiate and manage commercial agreements, drafting contracts that meet client needs while staying within Etihad's commercial guidelines.
 Track competitor, market, and industry intelligence to sharpen Etihad's selling approach and grow market share.
 Keep customer data accurate and current in Etihad's CRM, and complete required commercial training as a subject-matter expert in your patch.

Education & Experience 
 Bachelor's degree with 3+ years of experience in corporate accounts / B2B travel trade sales.
 Aviation industry experience essential, not a nice-to-have.
 Proven ability to manage multiple stakeholders across departments to hit shared commercial goals.
 Strong commercial and analytical skills,able to read market data and turn it into an actionable sales plan.
 Based in the UAE, with the flexibility to meet clients across the region.

Etihad Airways is more than the UAE’s national airline - we’re shaping the future of global aviation. From our hub in Abu Dhabi, we connect people across continents and cultures, while driving our “Journey 2030” ambition to double our fleet, expand our network and grow our people for a new era of excellence. Join us and become part of a vision where the world is your workplace and extraordinary experiences take flight.
 To learn more visit www.etihad.com 
 Recruitment Fraud Alert 

Beware of fraudulent job offers from individuals or organizations claiming to represent the Etihad group. We will never ask for personal information, bank details, or payment during the recruitment process. Interviews are conducted face-to-face or via video/telephone before any formal offer. If you are asked for money, please treat it as fraudulent.
